import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
export function WorkspacePage() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<{ id: string; name: string }[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true); setError(false);
    fetch("/api/resources", { signal: controller.signal }).then((response) => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Load failed");
      return response.json();
    }).then(setRows).catch(() => {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(true);
    }).finally(() => { if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false); });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [attempt]);
  return <section>
    <header className="legacy-page-header"><h1>Resources</h1><p>Your provisioned resources</p></header>
    <div className="legacy-surface">
      {loading ? <p role="status">Loading…</p> : error ? <div role="alert">Could not load resources.<button onClick={() => setAttempt(attempt + 1)}>Retry</button></div> : rows.length ? <ul>{rows.map((row) => <li key={row.id}>{row.name}</li>)}</ul> : <p>No resources yet.</p>}
    </div>
  </section>;
}
